interns.status: Currently accepting internship applications for Spring 2027
interns.intro: We offer clinical internships for counseling students. We may also have placements in housing and case management.
clinicalBullets: For students in the **second placement** of a master's program in **counseling**
Co-facilitate our Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP): **Monday, Wednesday and Friday, 9 a.m. to 12 p.m.**
Carry a small caseload of individual clients
Supervision is by an **LPCC**, so your program must accept that credential
Join group clinical supervision: **Mondays at 3 p.m., Wednesdays at 1 p.m. and Thursdays at 1 p.m.**
**In person only.** We do not offer remote internships.
interns.otherText: Placements may be available. Ask us about current openings.
